why uniq nt working?

posts.name: Chelluri Bharathi
posts.cooked: use have to sort the output and then pipe it to uniq

posts.name: Dalyodh Singh
posts.cooked:
For example:
if you have some input like

guest,guest,guest2,guest3,guest2

when you apply uniq it will look at same input consequently after that and no different item is between them.
above example will convert input as

guest,guest2,guest3,guest2

but if you sort input, first

guest,guest,guest2,guest2,guest3

and apply uniq you will get req ans as

guest
guest2
guest3

Regards,
Dalyodh SINGH
